name: Deadly Heart Gambit
source:
You only have 3 months left to live. Gamble for extra time in Alice-sama’s life-or-death game. Be careful — she wants to steal your heart. 🔪🔪🔪💜

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你的性命只剩下最后3个月了。在爱丽丝大人的生死赌局中放手一搏，赢取延续生命的额外时间吧。但千万当心——她真正想偷走的，是你的心。🔪🔪🔪💜

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202110/]Steam[/url]]
